about: The epistola of the formulary “Third Sunday after Epiphany” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: Brethren: Be not wise in your own conceits. Render to no man evil for evil; provide things good not only before God but also before all men. If it be possible, as far as lieth in you, have peace with all men. Avenge not yourselves, dearly beloved, but give place unto wrath; for it is written: Vengeance is Mine, I will repay, saith the Lord. But if thine enemy be hungry, feed him; if he thirst, give him drink. For in doing this thou shalt heap coals of fire upon his head. Be not overcome by evil, but overcome evil with good.
